# Shaka configuration

This repository uses Shaka contract `version: 1`. The files below hold its configuration.

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `shaka/config.yml` | Review, merge, and branch policy, read from the trusted default branch. Live GitHub settings still govern checks and approvals. |
| `shaka/trusted-github-actors.yml` | Whose public GitHub comments the agent may read. |
| `shaka/bin/` | Executable setup, test, and validation wrappers. Shaka runs the candidate checkout's copies; inspect changes before execution. |

## Check configuration edits

`shaka seam check --root . --local`

Validates the current checkout's YAML and scripts. Without `--ref`, it
grants no trusted policy authority.

## Load trusted policy

Resolve this repository's default branch to an immutable commit SHA, then:

`shaka seam check --root . --ref SHA`

A candidate PR cannot grant itself authority by changing its own policy.
